entities.summary: Zagazig University is a public university located in the city of Zagazig, Sharqia, Egypt. Founded in 1974, It comprises colleges and scientific institutes belonging to most branches of human knowledge, totaling 16 colleges and two institutes, with a third under construction, and more than 600 scientific departments.
